verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              उत सन्तमसन्तं वा बालं वृद्धं च सञ्जय। उताबलं बलीयांसं धाता प्रकुरुते वशे ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said The creator has, under his control, the good and the bad, the young and the old the weak and the strong.
verses.bhavadeepa: युक्तिः संभावना एतस्यार्थस्य न विद्यते । शक्रपुरीमिन्द्रप्रस्थम् ॥४९॥

verses.sanskrit: उत बालाय पाण्डित्यं पण्डितायोत बालताम्। ददाति सर्वमीशानः पुरस्ताच्छुक्रमुच्चरन् ॥२॥
verses.english: The supreme lord gives wisdom to the child and childishness to the wise, developing the seed in a being.
verses.bhavadeepa: उतेति । सन्तं साधुमसन्तं दुष्टं धाता ईश्वरः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: बलं जिज्ञासमानस्य आचक्षीथा यथातथम्। अथ मन्त्रं मन्त्रयित्वा याथातथ्येन हृष्टवत् ॥३॥
verses.english: To him (Dhritarashtra) desirous of knowing our strength should you say how matters really stand, having cheerfully held a consultation with a view to knowing the true information.

verses.sanskrit: गावल्गणे कुरून् गत्वा धृतराष्ट्रं महाबलम्। अभिवाद्योपसंगृह्य ततः पृच्छेरनामयम् ॥४॥
verses.english: O son of Gavalgani, going to the Kauravas, you should great king Dhritarashtra of great strength hand touching his feet ask him regarding his health.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूयाश्चैनं त्वमासीनं कुरुभिः परिवारितम्। तवैव राजन् वीर्येण सुखं जीवन्ति पाण्डवाः ॥५॥
verses.english: And you shall say to him, who will be seated surrounded by the Kurus-The sons of Pandu are living happily solely through your prowess.

verses.sanskrit: तव प्रसादाद्बालास्ते प्राप्ता राज्यमरिन्दम। राज्ये तान् स्थापयित्वाऽग्रे नोपेक्षस्व विनश्यतः ॥६॥
verses.english: It was through your grace, O subduer of enemies, that they thought mere boys obtained a kingdom. First establishing them in the kingdom, do not treat them with carelessness or they would be ruined.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमप्येतदेकस्य नालं सञ्जय कस्यचित्। तात संहत्य जीवामो द्विषतां मा वशं गमः ॥७॥
verses.english: All this kingdom is too much, O Sanjaya, for any body. You should say this speaking on our behalf-Sire, we shall live united; do not go into the clutches of despisers.

verses.sanskrit: तथा भीष्मं शान्तनवं भारतानां पितामहम्। शिरसाऽभिवदेथास्त्वं मम नाम प्रकीर्तयन् ॥८॥
verses.english: In the same way should you bow down your head, on my behalf, to the grandsire of the race of Bharata, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवाद्य च वक्तव्यस्ततोऽस्माकं पितामहः। भवता शन्तनोर्वंशो निमग्नः पुनरुद्धृतः ॥९॥
verses.english: After being greeted, our grandsire should thus be addressed-By you was the race, of Shantanu when about to be involved in ruin, was extricated.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं कुरु तथा तात स्वमतेन पितामह। यथा जीवन्ति ते पौत्राः प्रीतिमन्तः परस्परम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: You, who have done this, now do what according to your own opinion, O Grandsire, will enable your grandsons to live in peace and amity with each other.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव विदुरं ब्रूयाः कुरूणां मन्त्रधारिणम्। अयुद्धं सौम्य भाषस्व हितकामो युधिष्ठिरे ॥११॥
verses.english: In the same way should you thus speak to Vidura, the adviser of the Kurus, "O you peaceful one, advice peace, O you well wisher of Yudhishthira."

verses.sanskrit: अथ दुर्योधनं ब्रूया राजपुत्रममर्षणम्। मध्ये कुरूणामासीनमनुनीय पुनः पुनः ॥१२॥
verses.english: And then speak to the wrathful prince Duryodhana seated in the midst of the Kurus entreating him again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अपापां यदुपैक्षस्त्वं कृष्णामेतां सभागताम्। तद्दुःखमतितिक्षाम मा वधीष्म कुरूनिति ॥१३॥
verses.english: "The insults you have offered to the blameless Krishna who had been brought to this council hall, we will quietly endure so that the Kurus may not be slaughtered.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पूर्वापरान् क्लेशानतितिक्षन्त पाण्डवाः। बलीयांसोऽपि सन्तो यत्तत्सर्वं कुरवो विदुः ॥१४॥
verses.english: The Pandavas will quietly bear similar insults offered before and after that though they are strong enough. All this the Kauravas know.
verses.bhavadeepa: अतितिक्षाम क्षान्तवन्तो वयं तत्र हेतुः मावधीष्मेति ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: यन्नः प्रव्राजयेः सौम्य अजिनैः प्रतिवासितान्। तद्दुःखमतितिक्षाम मावधीष्म कुरूनिति ॥१५॥
verses.english: O amiable one, you sent us into exile with raiment's made of deer skin on. This hardship shall we quietly bear so that the Kurus may not be slaughtered.

verses.sanskrit: यत्कुन्तीं समतिक्रम्य कृष्णां केशेष्वधर्षयत्। दुःशासनस्तेऽनुमते तच्चास्माभिरुपेक्षितम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: O Dushasana, it was at your bidding that Krishna was dragged here by the hair setting at naught the protest of Kunti. That too is forgiven by us.

verses.sanskrit: अथोचितं स्वकं भागं लभेमहि परन्तप। निवर्तय परद्रव्याद्बुद्धिं गृद्धां नरर्षभ ॥१७॥
verses.english: But o repressor of enemies, we want our due share; O best among men, turn away your avaricious inclination from what belongs to others.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिरेवं भवेद्राजन् प्रीतिश्चैव परस्परम्। राज्यैकदेशमपि नः प्रयच्छ शममिच्छताम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: By this means, O king, there shall be peace and good will among each other; give back to us, who are desirous of peace, even one province out of the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: अविस्थलं वृकस्थलं माकन्दीं वारणावतम्। अवसानं भवत्वत्र किञ्चिदेकं च पञ्चमम् ॥१९॥
भ्रातॄणां देहि पञ्चानां पञ्चग्रामान् सुयोधन। शान्तिर्नोऽस्तु महाप्राज्ञ ज्ञातिभिः सह सञ्जय॥२०॥
verses.english: O Suyodhana, give but five villages to your five cousins and let there be peace among ourselves and our cousins, O Sanjaya of great wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: भ्राता भ्रातरमन्वेतु पिता पुत्रेण युज्यताम्। स्मयमानाः समायान्तु पाञ्चालाः कुरुभिः सह ॥२१॥
verses.english: Let brother follow brother and let father unite with son. Let the Panchala join the Kurus with a smiling face.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षतान् कुरुपाञ्चालान् पश्येयमिति कामये। सर्वे सुमनसस्तात शाम्याय भरतर्षभ ॥२२॥
verses.english: I desire that I shall see the Kauravas and the Panchalas, without any wounds and we shall all establish peace with cheerful hearts, O you best among the race of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: अलमेव शमायास्मि तथा युद्धाय सञ्जय। धर्मार्थयोरलं चाहं मृदवे दारुणाय च ॥२३॥
verses.english: I am surely ready for peace and to war as well, O Sanjaya. For the acquirement of wealth, am I surely prepared to mild measures and harsh ones.
